section.5: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them

5.name_native: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Umm Darda’ said:“Abu Darda’ told me that he did eleven prostrations* with the Prophet (ﷺ), including An-Najm.” *Eleven Ayaat of prostrations
